result.title: EC-EarthFlow: Probabilistic emulation of daily transient global climate model simulations with flow matching
result.summary: We introduce EC-EarthFlow, a generative flow matching model that emulates simulations from the physical climate model EC-Earth3. The model is trained on transient simulations from EC-Earth3 (1950-2166, SSP2-4.5) to predict the day ahead temperature field from the previous days temperature as well as annual mean temperature. Predictions are made auto-regressively with rollout periods of between a month and an extended season. Using only this variable of interest, we are able to reproduce the daily variability, spatial patterns, annual cycle and long-term trend from EC-Earth3 at a substantially lower computational cost than the physical model. We demonstrate that EC-EarthFlow is stable for long inference periods, and that it can learn the physical relationships as simulated in EC-Earth3.

AI.brief_summary: EC-EarthFlow 用 flow matching 生成模型自回归模拟 EC-Earth3 的逐日全球温度场，以远低于物理模式的成本复现日变率、空间格局与长期趋势。
